_comment: WF-V6 per-subject turnaround contract (scripts/v6/README.md), written by gold.mjs new 2026-09-28. Vehicle author frame: nose +z, near flank +x, y up, ground y = 0, x and z centred. No regions.json: families.table = flat colours of the concept; families.body names the body family.

anchor.why: 2026-09-29: the stated 14.6 m width is the main-rotor span (gunmetal, not the body family), so W cannot anchor; L = the olive body family nose-to-fin span, the stated 15.5 m nose-to-tail-rotor less the tail rotor / chin gun (~0.5 m)

families._enclosedFg: off until the setup audit decides (see-through parts stay background)
families._table: 2026-09-29 (v2 concept refs/attack_heli.v2.png): named from the concept's foreground colour clusters >= 2 % (newsubject.mjs proposeFamilies on the v2 image) + measure.mjs sample of each part: fuselage, tail boom, fin, stub wings and engine pods dark olive (shade / lit); metal = rotor blades, hub, mast, tail rotor, chin gun, rocket pods, intake grilles, antennas and skids gunmetal; glass = the canopy panels dark blue-grey; dark = canopy frame bars, outlines and shadowed olive
